article.title: ‘Economics’ is an ideology of the global North
article.author: Editor
article.content: The latest Nobel award confirms that conventional mainstream economics is a northern ideology dominated by a few U.S. universities. The discipline doesn’t have much to say about the majority world. The post ‘Economics’ is an ideology of the global North appeared first on MR Online .
